full_details: In the morning you began the third act, the king come home to Wales, and wrote half a sheet. At the Theatre Heminges named eight-and-twenty against last Saturday's four-and-thirty. James said the house stands, and that was his news. Nothing was paid out for the slippers. The chest was not counted. You were home for the call at ten past six. Cuthbert, from Holywell, gave you two years less a month, four-and-twenty pound where they pay fourteen, and a clause Allen would not explain. You said you will tell James a king is coming, and that it is long. Nothing was agreed. You did not write the letter home.
one_sentence: The reckoning gave you eight-and-twenty shillings and the news that the house stands, and at home you agreed nothing with Cuthbert.
title: Eight-and-twenty shillings, then Cuthbert from Holywell
